verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a full-service law firm. It is a professional-services provider, not a software product with an in-product interface, so the axis of delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant does not apply to its product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any software product or client-facing AI tool that would make the axis applicable. Its practice pages cover advising clients on AI, which is legal advice, not a product capability.
